---
title: "M1 - Standalone Module"
---

## Purpose

This standalone version demonstrates the capabilities of Module M1 - Text Generation as described in Villanova Task 1.7 (AI-based component development).

The demo shows how to generate coherent creative text from:

- A custom prompt
- Optional seed text
- Configurable generation parameters

## What This Demo Covers

- CLI-based execution of the text generation component
- Integration with an OpenAI-compatible Villanova LLM endpoint
- Reproducible usage for technical validation and demonstrations

## Technical Scope

The standalone module supports:

- Multilanguage text generation for reusable business scenarios
- Access to Villanova model families, including vertical and fine-tuned variants
- Admin-level configuration through no-code interaction patterns
- Reusable integration in composable and domain-specific use cases

## Technical Features

- PBC-based modular architecture for composition and reuse
- Support for both predefined setup profiles and advanced configuration options
- No-technical-skill administration for common setup and operational tuning
- Advanced prompt governance, including custom system prompt definition
- Optional chatbot delivery bundled with the component
- Compatibility with cloud, edge, and local environments

## Technical Assumptions

- A LLM endpoint is available and reachable
- The endpoint exposes an OpenAI-compatible API
- The organization enables an admin role to configure component behavior

## Technical Constraints

- The component depends on external inference services
- The module is intended for prototyping and experimental scenarios, while remaining reusable as a composable PBC

## Access and Integration Notes

The component can be exposed as a standalone capability or integrated into larger composable applications.
Administrative configuration can be performed through predefined settings for standard scenarios and advanced controls for specialized behavior, including system prompt updates.
When required by the use case, the same component can be packaged and delivered together with a chatbot front end.

## Prerequisites

Before running the demo, ensure the following:

1. Python 3.10+ is installed.
2. The component source code is available locally.
3. A Villanova-compatible model endpoint is running and reachable.
4. Python dependencies are installed.

## Suggested Project Layout

```text
villanova-genai-components-m1/
	source/
		story_generation_component.py
	examples/
		story_generation_prompt_it.txt
		story_example_seed_villanova_it.txt
```

## Install Dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

If `requirements.txt` is not provided, install the package used by the script directly.

## Run the Standalone Demo

```bash
python3 ./source/story_generation_component.py \
	--endpoint localhost \
	--port 8003 \
	--prompt examples/story_generation_prompt_it.txt \
	--seed examples/story_example_seed_villanova_it.txt \
	--temperature 0.9 \
	--max-tokens 512
```

## Parameters

- `--endpoint`: host name or IP of the LLM service
- `--port`: exposed API port of the LLM service
- `--prompt`: input text file with generation instruction
- `--seed`: optional seed text file
- `--temperature`: creativity/randomness control
- `--max-tokens`: maximum generated output length

## Expected Outcome

The command returns generated text based on prompt, seed and model settings.
This output can be used to validate M1 behavior during functional demonstrations and integration tests.
